_field_guide._about: Template input for: python3 ai_model_calculator.py --hardware <this-file>. When --hardware is used, ONLY the entries below are analyzed (the project's built-in hardware list is ignored). This '_field_guide' block is ignored by the loader; delete it or keep it as documentation.
_field_guide._accepted_shapes: This file uses the {"hardware": [...]} wrapper. The loader also accepts a bare list [ {...} ] or a single hardware object {...}.
_field_guide._required_fields: name, gpus, nodes, mem_gb, inter_node_bw_gb, intra_node_bw_gbps, peak_tflops_bf16. Missing any of these fails with a clear error.
_field_guide._units: gpus = total GPUs in the cluster; nodes = number of nodes; mem_gb = memory per GPU (GB); inter_node_bw_gb = per-GPU inter-node bandwidth (GB/s, e.g. EFA); intra_node_bw_gbps = intra-node link bandwidth (GB/s, e.g. NVLink/PCIe); peak_tflops_bf16 = per-GPU peak BF16 TFLOPS.
_field_guide._optional_fields: label is accepted but unused by the calculator. gpus_per_node is assumed to be 8 by the phase-5/phase-6 communication models and is not read from these entries.
_field_guide._validation_note: gpus must be divisible by TP*PP*CP (from configuration/project_config.py); otherwise validation fails. name is matched case-insensitively by --hw-name; keep names unique within this file.
